sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Mrs. Uttara Bahuguna, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2. The instant writ petition has been preferred for a direction to the respondents not to insist the petitioners to execute sale deed of their valuable land, treating it as remote agricultural land and for a further direction to the respondents to determine/calculate the compensation of the land of the petitioners as per provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Farhat Kamaal And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69148550/
1 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3.

entities.text: Farhat Kamaal And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel submits that the dispute falls within the jurisdiction of the District Level Committee constituted by the Government Order dated 12.5.2016 and as such no interference is required by this Court in the instant matter at this stage.
4.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the issue involved, with the consent of parties herein, the writ petition stands disposed of with observation that in case the petitioners move a fresh representation ventilating their grievances before the authority concerned constituted under the Government Order dated 12.05.2016 within two weeks, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law expeditiously,
